run_evaluate_from_checkpoint: run the evaluate script with a checkpoint file path to evaluate an experiment
run_reload_experiment_from_file: run reload_experiment_from_file to reconstruct an experiment object from a checkpoint file
run_experiment_evaluate: run the evaluate method on a reloaded experiment to assess performance
review_evaluate_cli: review the evaluate CLI module that loads and evaluates experiments from checkpoint files
summarize_evaluate_module: summarize the evaluate module that uses argparse to accept a checkpoint file and run evaluation
